hooks.name: Test Classifier on Save
hooks.description: Runs core package tests when classifier files are saved, detects property-based test failures, extracts counterexamples, and logs them to docs/kiro-log.md

action.command:
bash -c '
# Run tests and capture output
output=$(pnpm --filter core test 2>&1)
exit_code=$?

echo "=== Test Results ==="
echo "$output"
echo ""

# Check for failures
if [ $exit_code -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "❌ Tests failed"
  
  # Look for property-based test failures (fast-check patterns)
  if echo "$output" | grep -q "Property failed after"; then
    echo ""
    echo "🔍 Property-based test failure detected:"
    echo ""
    
    # Extract property name, counterexample, and context
    property=$(echo "$output" | grep -oP "(?<=Property: ).*" || echo "unknown")
    counterexample=$(echo "$output" | grep -A 10 "Counterexample:" | head -n 11)
    shrunk=$(echo "$output" | grep -A 5 "Shrunk.*:" | head -n 6)
    
    echo "Property: $property"
    echo "$counterexample"
    echo "$shrunk"
    
    # Append to kiro-log.md
    mkdir -p docs
    
    # Add PBT findings section if it doesn'\''t exist
    if ! grep -q "## PBT findings" docs/kiro-log.md 2>/dev/null; then
      echo "" >> docs/kiro-log.md
      echo "## PBT findings" >> docs/kiro-log.md
      echo "" >> docs/kiro-log.md
    fi
    
    # Append the failure
    {
      echo "### $(date +%Y-%m-%d\ %H:%M:%S)"
      echo "**Property:** $property"
      echo "\`\`\`"
      echo "$counterexample"
      [ -n "$shrunk" ] && echo "$shrunk"
      echo "\`\`\`"
      echo ""
    } >> docs/kiro-log.md
    
    echo ""
    echo "📝 Counterexample logged to docs/kiro-log.md"
  fi
else
  echo "✅ All tests passed"
fi

exit 0
'
